description: Election Commission - Iddamalgoda Bandaranayaka Sem Harishanth Sarathchandra was Selected as the Member of the Wennappuwa Pradeshiya Sabha Malavige Jagath Thushara Hemantha was Selected as the Member of the Millaniya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Wennappuwa Pradeshiya Sabha and Millaniya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, specifically the replacement of elected members who have resigned or ceased to be party members, which falls under election-related administrative matters. This fits Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it concerns electoral processes and local authority member appointments rather than general government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
